lines.text: Do you know how bats fly in total darkness? They shout, and listen to the echoes.
A bat sends out calls so high-pitched that we can't hear them. The sound bounces off everything around it.
How long the echo takes tells the bat how far away something is. Which ear hears it first tells it where.
Closing in on a moth, it calls faster and faster, up to about two hundred times a second.
Some moths fight back. They hear the bat coming and dive, and a few even click back to jam the signal.
Orbi Nearby finds what's close to you too. Phones on the same Wi-Fi show up for each other, with no login and no pairing.
